name: רַחַם
summary: A man of Judah, of the line of Caleb, son of Shema and father of Jorkeam (1Ch 2:44). The name is spelled as the pausal form of the noun רֶחֶם “womb”, which in Jdg 5:30 names a captive girl; why a man bore it is not said.

evidence.note: “Shema fathered רַחַם, the father of Jorkeam.”
רַחַם רַחֲמָתַיִם “a girl, two girls”: the same form as a common noun.

note: BDB key t.bz.ag also counts the Jdg 5:30 token, which is the common noun and is cited under רֶחֶם in racham.json. The Ugaritic rḥm “girl” and the goddess rḥmy (KTU 1.23) were not followed to DULAT. Some take the name as short for a name like Jerahmeel; not shown.
